SingleFileClrInfoProvider leads to symbols of all unmanaged modules to be enumerated. On big projects, it might take 3-5 seconds (on every debugger pause!). Since we do not support single file app debug (/p:PublishSingleFile=true), there is no need for SingleFileClrInfoProvider so we can remove it from the list of ClrInfoProviders.
Note that we have plans to support single file app debug in 263 and there will be a proper fix for this issue in 263.
